'''Hapoel Nof HaGalil Football Club''' ({{Langx|he|מועדון כדורגל הפועל נוף הגליל|Moadon Kaduregel Hapoel Nof HaGalil}}; {{langx|ar|هبوعيل نوف هچليل}}) is an Israeli professional football club based in [[Nof HaGalil]]. The club was formally known by the name "Nazareth Illit" until 2019 (the club accordingly was named as '''Hapoel Nazareth Illit F.C.'''). The club currently plays in {{Israeli football updater|HapNH}}."}}
